title: Be Holy, Because I Am Holy

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Do not defile yourselves by any of these creatures. Do not make yourselves unclean by means of them or be made unclean by them. I am the LORD your God; consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy. Do not make yourselves unclean by any creature that moves along the ground." - Lev 11:43-44 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
At last God gives the reason. After forty-two verses of animals and lists and carcasses, here is the heart of it all: be holy, because I am holy.

The food laws were never really about food. They were about a people learning, three times a day, that they belonged to a God unlike any other — set apart, pure, wholly good. Every meal was a lesson in distinctiveness.

Notice the order carefully, because it matters enormously. God does not say "be holy so that I will be your God." He says "I am the LORD your God — therefore be holy." Relationship first. Rescue first. He had already brought them out of Egypt. Holiness was the response, never the entrance fee.

That order has not changed. We are not made God's children by our purity. We are made His children by grace through faith in Christ, and then called to live like the family we have joined. Peter quotes this very verse to the church: as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do (1 Pet 1:15-16).

You are not working towards acceptance. You are living from it. And the God who calls you to holiness supplies the power for it by His Spirit.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you live as though holiness earns God's love, or flows from it?
2. What does "set apart" look like in your particular circumstances?
3. Which area of your life is God calling into greater holiness right now?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Holy Father, thank You that You claimed me before You called me. Make me holy as You are holy, not to win Your love but because I am already Yours in Christ. Amen.
